stages.name: Capture brief
stages.description: Turn the raw idea into a structured brief (goals, pages, brand, audience).

stages.name: Design & UI/UX
stages.description: Generate visual direction, layouts, fonts, color system and key imagery.

stages.name: Scaffold code + DB + architecture
stages.description: Generate a working Next.js app, DB schema and architecture notes into output/.

stages.name: Security audit
stages.description: Dependency CVEs, headers, auth misconfig and OWASP checks against OWN preview only.

stages.name: Preview deploy
stages.description: Push to GitHub and deploy a Vercel preview URL for review.

stages.name: Domain acquisition
stages.description: MONEY GATE. Check availability/price; purchase only after explicit human approval.

stages.name: Go live
stages.description: GO-LIVE GATE. Promote to production and point the domain at it.
